venues.name: D&C DC
venues.notes_summary: **DC — Saturday 2/21.** Busy and consistently so. Garden steady with a few pops; Jada rocked it solo with help from Josh and Tyler; Garden open past midnight due to steady walk-ins. Grant was the only server on the floor, with Josh taking tables and commanding expo; steady foot traffic until things slowed all at once ~1am, then a smooth close. Kitchen: steady, nearly 10% of sales. MOD: Josh / Cory.

venues.name: D&C EV
venues.notes_summary: **EV — Saturday 2/21.** Raucous yet measured night thanks to a better first turn: a family ripping stirred drinks, a NoLa bartender running the menu, food-tech guests. Two large parties placed within 15 minutes made a chunky flip, handled with creative room arrangement and timed cake cutting. Best table: a seven-top birthday that wanted vodka sodas; best moment: two last-minute tables from the same California alma mater, one bought fernet shots. Comps $165.42. Top sellers: First Time Listener, Year of the Trees, Material Control. Kitchen: epic family meal. Door: East Village popping on the warmest day of the year ahead of the storm; industry and friends (Erin Cusick, Mrinal, Toba, former employee Nelson Patino); packed until ~12:45; no incidents. Two no-shows: Carly Zelner, Kate Thompson. Repairs: downstairs bathroom door ajar.
